name: borrowdesk
description: Small command-line equipment lending desk for a community workshop.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-timeout=60000 "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js"
